description: This source file defines extension methods for the IServiceCollection interface to facilitate dependency injection in the Orleans.Serialization.Utilities.Internal namespace. The methods enable registering existing service implementations under different service types within a dependency injection container.

classes.name: InternalServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to register existing service implementations.

methods.name: AddFromExisting<TService, TImplementation>
methods.description: Registers an existing implementation of TImplementation as a provider for the service type TService by reusing an existing registration.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing registration of a service implementation Type for a specified service Type within the services collection.
